prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 8 "Administration fee": NOT indemnified (t = 0) in all 4 earlier cases; no price evidence

items.rationale: The swerve impact is covered under 2.6.2, and the battery health waiver disapplies the below-80% exclusion in 2.6.8. Under 7.1.10, the supplier’s uneconomic-repair report supports replacement; estimated equivalent new cost of €850 less €50 in salvage gives €800, with no stated deductible or sub-limit to apply.
Section 7.1.9 limits payment to the pre-loss specification. This separately billed upgrade is elective, so none of the difference is payable.
The tablet’s cracked screen is covered impact damage under 2.6.2–2.6.4. A like-for-like screen and fitting are estimated at €220 gross under 7.1.7 and 7.1.10, with no separate tablet deductible.

Section 5.2.3 covers necessary examination of both affected devices even when one is uneconomic to repair. At about €50 per device, the combined €100 is below the €250 gross event cap and assumes no diagnostic credit.
Under 4.2.6 and 7.1.5, a carry bag is only payable if it was itself damaged. None of the replacement cost is payable because the original bag was undamaged.
Sections 3.5(f) and 7.1.8(e) exclude the full cost of an extended warranty, even when sold with a covered replacement.
Sections 3.5(d) and 4.3(c) exclude data recovery unless separately scheduled. No data recovery endorsement is stated, and the battery health waiver does not provide one.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administration charges, including those levied by another provider engaged in the claim. No part of the fee is payable.
